sources.title: AI improving the tools that build AI
sources.claim: Google reports using AlphaEvolve to improve a kernel used in Gemini training, reducing total training time by 1%.
sources.limit: First-party report, not independently replicated here. This is one bounded improvement, not a recurring growth rate or autonomous self-improvement.
sources.reuse: Citation and original paraphrase; no publisher assets redistributed.

sources.title: A channel for useful capability to spread
sources.version: Original report v1; later v2 exists (4 January 2026)
sources.locator: Original report abstract; DeepSeek-R1 repository README §§1–3, 7
sources.claim: DeepSeek released R1/R1-Zero weights and six distilled models. Released weights make local use and adaptation possible.
sources.limit: Weights do not provide free serving, guaranteed reliability or a reproduced training stack. Upstream Qwen/Llama terms still matter.
sources.reuse: Cite original report; no model files redistributed. Repository MIT and upstream conditions are separate.

sources.title: China’s programme reaches from models into production
sources.organization: State Council; official National Data Administration reproduction
sources.claim: The AI+ opinion calls for stronger foundational models, integration into production workflows, application testing bases and shared industry platforms.
sources.limit: Programme intentions do not establish completed integrations. Draft translation: native-language human review is not recorded. Direct gov.cn access failed; the existing registry URL has a one-digit discrepancy.
sources.reuse: Original Chinese source linked; English paraphrase is AI-assisted and pending native-language review.

sources.title: A laboratory does not own its entire supply network
sources.claim: ASML reports specialized single-source dependencies, including Carl Zeiss SMT optics, and manufacturing operations across the Netherlands, Germany, US, South Korea and Taiwan.
sources.limit: Company risk disclosure; it does not quantify disruption probability or establish a permanent inability to substitute or expand.
sources.reuse: ASML reserves rights; factual paraphrase only, no copied graphics.

sources.title: Physical deployment can change, too
sources.locator: Executive summary: Smarter is faster; There are large uncertainties

sources.title: AI as Normal Technology
sources.locator: Introduction; Part I: The Speed of Progress
sources.claim: The authors distinguish invention, application and diffusion, emphasizing institutional change and arguing for a slower social trajectory.
sources.limit: An argued predictive account, not an observed law fixing the pace of future AI. It competes with rapid-compounding premises.

controls.label: Research feedback
controls.rule: Repeated advances activates the proposed research-to-next-system feedback. Bounded improvements leaves useful AI in research but does not close a self-reinforcing loop. Neither option supplies a rate.

controls.label: Useful capability reaches rivals
controls.rule: Earlier diffusion gives Chinese developers and third-country adopters access to the relevant usable capability. It weakens the exclusive-access route to leverage, without transferring chips, trained staff, ownership or all frontier research capabilities for free.

controls.label: AI changes the production path
controls.rule: Validated redesign adds a proposed route from AI-assisted engineering into repeatable physical deployment and feedback from operations. It stipulates that validation, equipment and people arrive together; existing-path mode retains separate qualification and integration work. No stage is removed silently.

controls.label: Investment and political bargain

options.label: Conflict or loss of effective control

controls.rule: This bundled choice shifts a fixed discretionary agenda among frontier experiments, deployment and access/assurance. It changes ownership and procurement assumptions as well as priorities. It is not a measured national trait. A compact requires verification and cooperation; rupture withdraws benign outcome claims.

presets.title: The lead compounds
presets.description: Give the frontier case its strongest conditions: repeated research advances, protected access and validated changes to the production path.

presets.title: Capability spreads
presets.description: Useful capability reaches rivals and adopters before exclusive control turns into durable power. Deployment and ownership become contested advantages.

presets.title: Powerful systems, divided societies
presets.description: Production improves across several locations while ownership and access concentrate the gain. Diffusion between firms is not distribution within societies.

presets.title: Coordinated limits and missions
presets.description: A credible agreement restrains the frontier race and prioritizes permitted applications. Verification, defection and opportunity costs remain live questions.

author.opening: Conversations in Washington and my experience at the World AI Conference in Shanghai kept bringing me back to the same question: if a country gets better AI first, what does it get to do that others cannot?
author.judgment: I want to take the compounding case seriously. If AI improves the research that produces its successors—and helps redesign the machinery around it—a lead could become much more than an advantage in chat software. The difficult question is whether control over that process stays exclusive long enough to become durable power.
author.closing: I care about who gets to decide what this power is for. A state could become harder to coerce while many of its citizens gain little. A society could become healthier or more capable without owning the leading laboratory. I want the comparison to keep both possibilities in view.
